say:0:1631202001:1.text: You hold the ring you found on Lava Isle in your palm. It seems to be the source of that faint, elusive voice.

say:1:1631202002:1.text: The metal is warm to the touch. Inside the band, an inscription is carved in a wildly flamboyant script, as if shouting about its own extraordinary origins.
say:1:1631202002:1.source_cn: 戒指触感温热，内圈刻着一行你看不懂、但风格极其浮夸的艺...

say:2:1631202003:1.text: As you study it, a seductive whisper echoes directly in your mind...

say:7:1631202007:0.text: <style="highlight">... the power to never grow tired. Endless overtime!</style>

say:9:1631202008:0.text: "Never tired? Overtime?!" The realization hits you like a cold splash of water. This isn't an artifact of great magic, it's an artifact of eternal unpaid labor.
say:9:1631202008:0.source_cn: “永不疲劳？加班？！”这可怕的念头让你一个激灵，瞬间清醒。
